findings.title: Failed USE on shard-aware connection has no fallback/retry
findings.claim: The Err(Keyspace) branch ignores evt.requested_shard, unlike Err(Connection) which falls back to the regular port. A server failing USE on shard-aware connections grows the backoff without the shard-aware port being retried or blocked.

findings.title: Failed USE log downgraded from warn! to debug!
findings.claim: The old code logged a failed USE at warn! level; the new branch logs at debug!, so a persistent keyspace failure only shows up as reconnect churn if the pool still has connections.

findings.title: PR description omits roughly half the diff (metrics changes)
findings.claim: The metrics changes—new decrement_total_connections calls in maybe_reshard and both places clearing excess connections, plus three new tests for them—are missing from the PR description, and its '2 passed' only covers the keyspace tests; this bookkeeping fix should be called out separately from the title's fix.

findings.title: New async test can hang due to missing timeout
findings.claim: keyspace_setup_failure_preserves_pool_state calls refiller.ready_connections.next().await twice with no timeout, so a regression in the proxy or USE path would hang the test instead of failing it, unlike full_pool_clears_excess_connections_and_balances_metrics which does use a timeout.
